description: Expected reference-validator results for each conformance fixture. A fixture is a miniature repository in a known shape; the corpus runner compares the validator's exit code and findings against this file.

fixtures.name: grade-a
fixtures.summary: The common spine only: README, SECURITY, and one skill whose frontmatter name matches its directory.

fixtures.name: grade-b
fixtures.summary: The spine plus the anti-rot core: current-state, an immutable decision log, a research register, and a machine-readable evidence index.

fixtures.name: advisory-shapes
fixtures.summary: A real decision log and research record written in shapes the validator does not parse. Both are advisory, never a failure.
soft: docs/decisions.md has no entries in a recognised shape; the decision schema and the research-to-decision edge are not machine-checkable here
docs/research/index.md has no '| R-### | ... |' rows; the research-to-decision edge is not machine-checkable in this shape

fixtures.name: stale-evidence
fixtures.summary: A machine-readable evidence index whose single entry is older than the freshness window.
hard: evidence 'Stale fixture source' was last verified 400 days ago (limit 180); revalidate or mark it stale

fixtures.name: broken
fixtures.summary: A missing spine file, a decision with no status, an unregistered source, and no research register.
hard: decision 'Ship the fixture without a status' is missing a non-empty Status field
decision 'Ship the fixture without a status' cites an unregistered source 'https://example.invalid/unregistered' (add it to docs/evidence-urls.json)
soft: decision 'Ship the fixture without a status' has no ID (an ID is how a research entry enables the decision)
docs/decisions.md exists but docs/research/index.md is missing (the research-to-decision edge is not yet recorded)

fixtures.name: standard-document
fixtures.summary: A STANDARD.md that carries a version and normative language but no lifecycle section, and a current-state document whose review date is past the freshness window.
hard: STANDARD.md has no '## Standard lifecycle' section
docs/current-state.md was last reviewed 400 days ago (limit 180); review the standard

fixtures.name: payload-boundary
fixtures.summary: A skill whose name matches its directory but whose body links out of its own payload directory.
hard: skills/example/SKILL.md links outside its skill directory to '../../README.md'

fixtures.name: skill-name-mismatch
fixtures.summary: A skill directory whose SKILL.md frontmatter name does not match the directory name.
hard: skill frontmatter name 'other' does not match its directory 'example'

fixtures.name: undocumented-gate
fixtures.summary: A hook that runs a script the README verification block does not document. Advisory, not a failure.
soft: a hook or workflow runs 'scripts/undeclared.py', which no README verification block documents

fixtures.name: evidence-shape
fixtures.summary: An evidence index missing a version and a description, with an entry that lacks expected statuses and carries a malformed date, plus a non-object entry.
hard: evidence 'Broken entry' has no non-empty integer expected_statuses
evidence 'Broken entry' has a malformed last_verified 'not-a-date'
